seo.meta_title: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend: Taste, Story & How to Brew
seo.meta_description: Major Dickason's Blend is Peet's best-selling coffee, a dark roast created with a customer in 1969. How it tastes, the story behind it and how to brew it.
seo.h1: What Is Peet's Major Dickason's Blend?

question: What Is Peet's Major Dickason's Blend?
quick_answer: Major Dickason's Blend is Peet's Coffee's all-time best-selling coffee: a dark roast blend of beans from the Americas and the Indo-Pacific with a rich, full-bodied, earthy flavor. It was created in 1969 with Key Dickason, a regular customer and retired army sergeant, and Alfred Peet named it after him, 'promoting' him to major. You can buy it as whole beans, ground coffee, K-Cup pods and decaf, and order it brewed at Peet's cafes.
key_facts: Beans from the Americas and Indo-Pacific
Created in 1969 with customer Key Dickason
Sold as whole bean, ground, K-Cups and decaf

body.heading: The story behind the name
body.text: Alfred Peet opened his first coffee shop in Berkeley, California, in 1966. In 1969, a loyal customer named Key Dickason, a retired army sergeant, brought him an idea for a new blend. The two tasted many combinations before settling on the final recipe. Peet decided that naming the coffee after his friend wasn't enough, so he gave him a promotion from sergeant to major, and Major Dickason's Blend was born.

body.heading: How it tastes
body.text: Major Dickason's is a dark roast, in Peet's signature deep roast style. Peet's describes it as rich, complex and full-bodied with earthy notes, and some bags mention notes of earth and spice. It blends beans from the Americas and the Indo-Pacific, including washed and wet-hulled coffees. If you like bold, low-acid coffee, it's a classic pick.

body.heading: Where to buy it
body.text: You can order Major Dickason's brewed at Peet's cafes when it's the featured coffee, or buy beans to take home. It's sold whole bean and ground in bags, as K-Cup pods and in a decaf version, both on Peet's website and in many grocery stores. On Peet's site, a one-pound bag is listed around $19.95, and grocery prices vary.

body.heading: How to brew it
body.text: Peet's suggests a French press for a full-bodied cup, and the blend also works as espresso. A common starting ratio on Peet's bags is about 4 tablespoons of ground coffee per 12 fluid ounces of water. Use a coarser grind for French press and a fine grind for espresso.

body.heading: Other Peet's blends
body.text: If you like Major Dickason's, Peet's also makes Big Bang, a medium roast created for its 50th anniversary,. For drink prices at Peet's cafes, see our Peet's Coffee menu page.

faqs.q: Is Major Dickason's a dark roast?
faqs.a: Yes. It's a dark roast, Peet's signature style.
Key Dickason, a regular Peet's customer and retired army sergeant who helped create the blend in 1969. Alfred Peet 'promoted' him to major in the name.

faqs.q: What does Major Dickason's taste like?
faqs.a: Rich, complex and full-bodied, with earthy, slightly spicy notes.

faqs.q: Is there a decaf Major Dickason's?
faqs.a: Yes. Peet's sells a decaf version.

faqs.q: Does Major Dickason's come in K-Cups?
faqs.a: Yes. It's sold as K-Cup pods as well as whole bean and ground coffee.
